# Source

Unmodified copy of `tests/draft7` and `remotes` from the JSON-Schema-Test-Suite
at commit `bcf1dc81ae099ade2a9642c672c06ee1af1bb489`.

That is the commit pinned by the `json-schema-benchmark` draft-07 run, the
benchmark suite referenced from ajv's README as the published performance and
conformance benchmark. The `json-schema-benchmark` runner uses these same files
as its cases and data.

License: MIT (see `LICENSE`). Only draft-07 is vendored because this package
implements ajv's default dialect.
